test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Rakesh is the owner of a rectangular field. Because of the construction of an expressway near his field, the length and breadth of his field are reduced by 30% and 10%, respectively. What is the percentage decrease in the area of his field?
solution:
**Given:**

Original length of the field = L

Original breadth of the field = B

New length of the field = 70% of L = 0.7L

New breadth of the field = 90% of B = 0.9B

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Decrease in Area = ((Original Area - New Area) / Original Area) × 100

**Calculation:**

Original Area = L × B

New Area = 0.7L × 0.9B

New Area = 0.63LB

Percentage Decrease in Area = ((L × B - 0.63LB) / L × B) × 100

⇒ Percentage Decrease in Area = ((LB - 0.63LB) / LB) × 100

⇒ Percentage Decrease in Area = (0.37LB / LB) × 100

⇒ Percen
tage Decrease in Area = 0.37 × 100

⇒ Percentage Decrease in Area = 37%

**The percentage decrease in the area of Rakesh's field is 37%.**
